decision: use six dependent PRs with high verification rigor
why: authentication private media and production infrastructure have high blast radius
the marketing and private production applications have different users data and release cadence

decision: use native D1 for Better Auth and direct prepared SQL for Studio
why: one metadata store and no unused abstraction keeps request traces short

decision: use authenticated Worker-mediated R2 multipart uploads
why: parts stay below request limits while every byte write retains session authorization

decision: start with authenticated R2 range playback and defer Stream
why: the requested controls work for browser-compatible exports and format fixtures can prove whether transcoding is needed

decision: use Cloudflare Email Routing sends restricted to verified product users
why: the account has Email Service but currently shows no eligible Email Sending zones while verified destination sends remain Cloudflare-native

decision: create verify-studio in PR STUDIO-01 and maintain it after every later direct proof
why: a runnable verification contract must exist before feature breadth grows
each PR should land as a coherent production-shaped increment instead of one coupled final stack

decision: let the root review evidence and merge without an operator pause
why: the user granted autonomous implementation and merge authority

decision: use D1 as the sole runtime allowlist source
why: a fixed application list would drift from administrator revocation

decision: fail builds that emit an environment file or a sentinel secret value
why: Cloudflare Vite copies an app-local .dev.vars file into its server output
